hypothesis: Training-disjoint conditional utility with matched ordinary/quality gates

config.hypothesis: Conditional candidate-set identity CE benefit of causal constructed IR, estimated from training-disjoint frozen teachers; algorithmic intervention, not new physical information.
config.representation: post_neck, original crop, fixed last epoch12 teachers; this first trial is distinct from the prospective long-axis baseline repair
config.teacher_folds: protocol_v2 crossfit_groups; each sequence encoded only by the teacher that did not train on it
config.candidate_policy: Original RGB baseline high/unconfirmed stage geometry IoU>=0.1, valid RGB crop, RGB distance<=0.35. Both teachers use exactly that row candidate set plus fixed NULL. RGB candidate eligibility is decided before IR scoring.
config.target: CE(-RGB distance / T, true candidate or NULL) minus CE(-[0.5 RGB+0.5 IR] distance / T, same label). Missing IR gives exact RGB. Classifier CE over unknown heldout identities is forbidden.

physical_proposal_labels.matching: independent per-current-frame IoU Hungarian, no temporal continuity bonus
physical_proposal_labels.ambiguity: Reject nonunique physical assignments and original duplicate GT keys. Unlabeled crops remain tracker inputs but cannot anchor supervision.

config.history: Actual accepted RGB-baseline online histories, EMA0.9, max8 observations; original first available unambiguous past label anchors supervision only. Scoring before current writes. Also retain clean teacher-forced history indices as a diagnostic, never inference inputs.
config.calibration: Fit scalar affine utility calibration on the held-out association-training video only; canonical dev does not fit estimator or calibration. Report near-constant/sign failure honestly.
config.sampling: Uniform fit video, then uniform query within video; no canonical-dev sampling
config.loss: Huber utility regression, delta0.1; ordinary same-evidence and quality-only gates optimize the identical candidate CE with the same MLP/budget
config.selection: fixed epoch8; dev all-seed mean HOTA then AssA/IDF1, compare strongest completed BoT-SORT and identity-blind geometry baseline, not just ordinary RGB
controls: independent RGB and matched RGB history/contrast views
config.scope: Prospective first CMUE experiment; no trained utility or method performance claim. Native trackers share proposals but not all native edge rules, so strongest native baseline is a separate full association comparator. NULL is supervised for utility estimation; deployment initially preserves native Hungarian/lifecycle unmatched decisions.

checkpoint_selection: Fixed epoch8; only association-training SN-015 calibrates utility
conclusion: Completed measured training/calibration; no independent module benefit or final-test outcome established.
